name: Harlo Barnaby
summary: In Menethil Harbor, Harlo Barnaby bears the wounds of Dun Modr's fall. The dwarven refugee escaped the Dark Iron assault and warns travelers of the tragedy in the northern marshes.

sections.title: Escape from Dun Modr
sections.body: Harlo Barnaby fled Dun Modr when Dark Iron dwarves struck the northern stronghold without warning. In the chaos, a stray axe hit him square in the back. The blow knocked him unconscious, yet he survived the trek across the marshland. Harlo awoke bandaged in Menethil Harbor, alive but marked by his wounds and memories of the massacre. He cannot return to Dun Modr, so he urges Alliance adventurers to investigate the smoking ruins of his former home.

faq.answer: Harlo Barnaby survived the Dark Iron assault on Dun Modr and now lives in Menethil Harbor. He is an Ironforge dwarf.

faq.q: How did Harlo Barnaby end up in Menethil Harbor?
faq.answer: Harlo Barnaby fled Dun Modr and was struck in the back by a thrown axe. He lost consciousness during his retreat and woke in Menethil Harbor, where local healers cared for him.
Dark Iron dwarves pushing south from the Thandol Span overran and devastated Dun Modr. The attack wiped out the local dwarven defenders and drove survivors into the wetlands.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you see in Harlo a living reminder of the bloody clan war against the treacherous Dark Irons, who seek to sever Khaz Modan from the north.
As an Alliance member, you know Dun Modr's fall threatens the critical land bridge between the marshlands and Arathi. Harlo's warnings matter to Alliance forces.
